description:
Generate Python strategy code only: nothing is trained or deployed.

    Returns the generated code for the user to read or edit; each call is billed
    from the account's credits.

    Args:
      features: Plain-English description of features (e.g. "RSI 14, Bollinger Bands").
      signals: Plain-English description of signal logic (e.g. "Buy when RSI < 30").
      model: ML model name (default Random Forest).
      risk: Plain-English risk rules (e.g. "0.5% stop loss").
      description: Optional one-line summary; the generator weighs it as the
        main request.
      symbol: Currency pair the code should target. One of: EURUSD, USDJPY,
        GBPUSD, USDCHF, USDCAD, AUDUSD, NZDUSD. Default EURUSD.
      timeframe: Candle granularity. One of: 1min, 5min, 15min, 1h. Default 15min.
      claude_model: "sonnet" (default) or "haiku" (faster, about a third of the credits).
name: generate_strategy
title: Generate Strategy Code (no training)
